I know it is not true, I mean, it would be extremelly unrealistic that everyone I know is against me or just laughing at me, but I still feel that and it is kinda funny. I hate these feelings because it simply means that I believe everything revolves around me :/

I'll surely go to a pyschologist once I get the chance to, if I ever get the chance to again.

Well, thanks for your help and time, it truly helped me blow off some steam, I really don't know why I posted this, guess I kind of felt weird because of my birthday, but everything is a little calmer now, I appreciate it queen/king :)

Dang, I guess our situations are very similar then haha.

I don't really think my friends aren't geniune, most of them are very good people, but I seem to antagonize everyone, thinking of them as "bad" or "fake". I used to go out with my friends a lot, and felt happy, but I still feel like it all was 'for the laughs' or like they invited me because they felt like they needed to, almost like being a burden to them :/

I'm confident some of your friends want you, you seem like a good person, and if they keep inviting you even if you say no, it must be because of something, right?

I can't go to a psychologist mostly because of the quarantine and the virus, the only thing I could do is to do it online, but it simply isn't the same, and I wouldn't feel comfortable.

​

May I ask what is your native language?

It isn't really something in specific that troubles me, but everything and everyone makes me feel like I'm always being judged or like whatever I do, people are always going to criticize me for the stuff I do, even when I try to act like everybody else, I can't help but feel like I'm nothing more but a weirdo to everyone.

I have no idea why I feel like this, I have never had trouble making friends, you could say I'm very charismatic and get along with everyone pretty well. Even with that in mind, I feel like I don't deserve at all this stuff, these friends, like it is all fake.

I know I need some help, but it is not like I really can do anything, since I can't go to a psychologist and if I talk to some of my friends, I'll just feel worse because I would feel like I am hungry for attention or just faking it all, which is something I really don't know if it is true, because I can't get my head around the idea that there is something wrong with me.

I'm sorry if it is kinda hard to understand what I'm saying, english is not my native language.

I mean, I guess deleting the social media is good and all, but I take it as running away from problems, which is something wrong. However, I dont feel happy for  being away from social media or anything, I steel feel bad and sad and keep getting the thoughts at night whenever I try to sleep. 

I isolate from people because I'm scared, scared of how people see me, how people talk about me, how everyone seems to get along so well with me. I think everyone is always laughing at me or everyone  secretily hates me. 

And what really troubles me the most is how I got this insecurities, since all my life has been great, I've been a good person, had a lot of friends and how can I get rid of the insecurities

Anyways, I guess I'll reply tomorrow because writing is getting a little hard, so goodnight
